forecast.scope: the zones of the plan it was made with, and what is done already

draft:
This week, 4 survey teams and 4 clearance teams were active. They completed 1 zone survey, with no visits, technical surveys or clearances. So far, 10 zones have been surveyed; 2 have been declared free, 3 areas released, 1 area cleared and 1 area found to contain mines.

No teams were stood down or had reports overdue by more than a week. No dossiers or reports were held or queried, and no zones were declared free this week. The access feed shows 12 zones closed. No new plan was approved; the plan remains P03. There were 23 team-days worked and 17 lost to rain or wind.

The forecast, made in week 10 for the zones of the plan it was made with and counting what is done already, gives a range of 10 to 14 mine areas cleared this season and 10 to 14 zones declared free this season.
